subject: Partner cross-pollination: convert external lessons into native Bonfÿre organs and export Bonfÿre proofs back as bounded contributions

body.objective: Partner work is not a side lane. It is an organ exchange loop.
targets: Bernstein: independent observer, clean-room/project-side verification, signed protocol/transport separation -> ReceiptEnvelope/WitnessDAG/AuthorityGraph and volunteer-worker ForeignTwin lessons.
Fraise: provenance versus ranking explanation, cache identity, bounded source, explanation versioning -> EvidenceGraph/ContextCompiler memory semantics.
DeepEval: divergence/resynchronization metrics -> Replay/Shadow/Backtesting comparison primitives.
AgentGuard: hostile path/loading boundaries -> ObjectFabric/path authority and trace ingestion fences.
Runpod v2: versioned API migration + contradictory retirement evidence -> APIUseTwin, TraceDivergence and contract-expiry handling.
Cursor Agent Trace: portable trace schema -> OTel/EvidenceGraph import projection.
verifier PR #8: canonical provider identity + capability-shape validation -> ProviderGraph identity fences.
required_actions: Build a partner-to-native lesson ledger with exact local target owner, implemented/proposed state, validity envelope and regression witness.
Where a lesson is already implemented, prove it rather than duplicate it.
Where Bonfÿre has a stronger proved primitive, prepare a bounded upstream-ready artifact or review draft but do not create unauthorized external effects.
Use cross-provider review for at least one imported lesson and one exported lesson.
